sentences.text: Once upon a time, upon an uninhabited island near the endless blue expanse of the sea, there lived a certain animal known as the Rhinoceros.
This creature possessed no skin such as other beasts wore, but instead was clad in a smooth, gleaming coat that buttoned up tightly from his stubby tail right to his pointed horn.
He had neither manners nor companionship, choosing to live entirely by himself in solitary indifference to the world around him.
All day long he did nothing save consume vast quantities of foliage, driven by an insatiable appetite that knew no bounds.
His existence was a monotonous routine of grazing until one fine morning when the quiet solitude of his domain was interrupted forever.
A man from a ship arrived on that very shore, stepping out from the foam with a heart full of purpose and a mind for domestic comfort.
Without delay, the traveler constructed a temporary hearth of flat stones, creating a sturdy place to cook his daily meals.
He kindled a great fire of dry wood, letting the amber flames leap into the salt air while he prepared a magnificent, sweet cake.
The pastry was rich with spices and honey, sending a fragrance so intensely wonderful that it drifted far across the gentle water.
Borne upon the breeze, the aroma reached the solitary animal deep within the interior of the island, awakening his curiosity.
When the animal smelled this miraculous food, he could not resist its pull and came crashing through the dense tropical trees to investigate.
He emerged upon the sunlit beach, his small eyes fixing upon the cooking place where the sweet creation sat cooling in the morning light.
Because there were no chairs or tables anywhere to be found, the busy man had been forced to leave his precious meal unguarded on the ground while he walked away.
Seizing the opportunity without a moment of hesitation, the creature clambered heavily onto the stone structure.
Before the owner could return, the animal had devoured the entire cake in a single greedy swallow, leaving nothing behind.
Moments later, the man returned from his brief absence, only to find his cooking place bare and his culinary labor utterly ruined.
He looked down at the empty stones and felt a deep surge of anger toward the magnificent yet intolerable beast standing nearby.
Realizing that mild words would be wasted, the man decided that a stern lesson must be administered so the creature would never steal again.
He concealed his frustration beneath a calm exterior and waited patiently until the heavy animal wandered back to his shady resting spot.
Under the branches of a sprawling green tree, the giant soon fell into a deep, contented slumber, completely unaware of impending retribution.
While the creature slept soundly, the clever man gathered a vast quantity of stale, sticky cake crusts and intensely sweet crumbs from his remaining provisions.
Working with quiet determination, he filled every available space inside the animal's unbuttoned coat, packing the sugary mass tightly against the bare hide.
He secured the buttons so firmly that the smooth garment strained against the sudden bulk, pressing the sweet mixture directly into the sleeping flesh.
When the animal finally stirred and woke from his slumber, he did not feel refreshed as usual, but instead experienced a violent, burning sickness.
An unbearable itch spread across his massive body, filling him with a frantic desire for relief that he could neither scratch nor soothe.
Desperate to alleviate his torment, the poor creature rushed blindly toward a jagged stone formation near the edge of the shore.
He rubbed his enormous sides against the sharp rock with all his might, hoping to scratch away the misery hidden beneath his clothes.
However, this desperate action only made the terrible problem infinitely worse, grinding the sticky sugar deeper into his sensitive skin.
Finding no comfort against the stone, the suffering beast plunged straight into the cool water and thrashed about in the wet earth.
The damp soil clung fiercely to his heated body, baking rapidly under the relentless rays of the tropical sun until it formed a hard crust.
Under the combined pressure of the dried earth and the old buttons that were now pulled far too tight, his entire appearance changed.
The once smooth and gleaming coat was stretched beyond endurance, warping into a permanent prison of thick, heavy folds.
Deep lines and overlapping ridges formed across his shoulders and flanks, staying fixed in place forever as the transformation became complete.
From that fateful day until the present era, every single rhinoceros has walked the earth wearing this heavy, wrinkled armor as a permanent reminder.
All of this occurred simply because a creature with no manners chose to consume a meal that belonged to someone else.
The story of this strange transformation is still known to nearly every traveler who visits the island today.
Tourists often stare at the heavy, folded skin and reminisce about the morning when the stranger baked his famous meal.
If the animal had resisted temptation, his coat would surely have remained smooth and soft through all the passing years.
Instead, the singular event altered his destiny forever, condemning him to bear the heavy burden of his own greed.
As for the man who built the cooking place, he never saw the animal again after that eventful morning, choosing to sail away forever.
He returned to his vessel and raised the anchor, gliding away across the blue sea toward distant lands unknown.
The island remained quiet and peaceful for many years following the incident, undisturbed save for the wind and the crashing waves.
Yet the memory of what happened lingered on the breeze, whispered from one generation of travelers to the next.
Visitors walking along the shore today can still catch a glimpse of the heavy animal resting lazily near the water's edge.
Guides point toward the giant with a knowing smile, recounting the tale to every newcomer who steps onto the warm sand.
Children listen with wide eyes and breathless attention, pondering the strange fate of the creature who loved sweets too much.
They learn the timeless lesson that taking things without permission often leads to surprising and permanent consequences in life.
The animal himself does not mind the spectators who watch him from a safe distance, remaining entirely unbothered by their presence.
His thick, folded skin protects him efficiently from the harsh sun and keeps him comfortable throughout the long tropical day.
Life on the island moves with a slow, unchanging rhythm for the beast who lost his smooth coat so many centuries ago.
Tourists continue to arrive by boat, eager to photograph the remarkable lines and deep ridges upon the giant's broad back.
Parents tell the amusing legend to their children as they walk together along the sparkling coastline at sunset.
It all began with a simple sweet cake, an unsatisfied appetite, and a clever traveler who believed in practical instruction.
The island remains a cherished destination for curious minds from all around the world who seek to witness living history.
And so the tale is preserved, living on in the hearts of everyone who hears the story of the thick skin.
